title: BalancePet appearance catalog v1
description: The index of installable appearance packages, published from the appearance repository. Its identity field is what distinguishes it from the main repository's plugin catalog, which is otherwise the same shape.

id.description: Package id. The appearance identifier a saved setting stores is the package's style, not this value.

description.description: One line saying what the appearance is. Shown under its name in the store, which is where a reader decides whether to download twelve megabytes.

version.description: The package's own version; an installed copy is compared against it to decide whether an update is offered.

min_core_version.description: An entry newer than the running program is listed but not installable.

icon_url.description: A small square picture of the appearance, which the store draws for an entry nobody has installed yet: the artwork is inside a twelve megabyte package, so a list cannot preview it any other way. Optional, and a host that does not know the field ignores it. It is the only field that can be dropped rather than refusing the entry, because an appearance with an unusable thumbnail is still an appearance that installs.

sha256.description: Digest of the artifact at download_url, verified after the download and before the install. Lower-case hexadecimal.

categories.description: The selector groups by category, so an entry says which it belongs to rather than leaving the reader to infer it from the name.
